title: Let an AI run a 50x gamble on ETH. Doubled in a day, gave most of it back the next
author: Lanky_Wear_4905
selftext:
Wanted to try having an AI build me a degen strategy. ETH, 50x, all in. Take profit when the account is up 160%, cut it when it's down half. Tested it on a Binance demo account first.

First trade was a short, hit take profit in 19 hours. 5,859 to 15k, +9,539 USDT.

Should have stopped there, but the strategy was set to keep going after a win and I couldn't be bothered to turn it off. Second trade, another 50x short. It was up 1,869 at one point, then ETH moved up about 1% and at 50x that was enough to hit the stop. -7,001 USDT.

After fees I'm still up 1,795 USDT across both trades. Fees alone were 743 USDT. 50x really eats you alive on fees.

Anyone else running AI on a demo account? What are you testing? Happy to share how I set mine up if anyone wants to know.
